theorems.name: Submission.cmr_abs_integral_div_le_mass
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (m + 1)) (θ : Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (b D : Euclid P → ℝ) (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (ζ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (K : ℝ), W ⊆ U → T.massOn W ≠ ∞ → T.boundary.massOn W ≠ ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (ω : TestFormOn U k) (r : ℝ), S.massOn W ≠ ∞ → tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) ⊆ W → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ≤ r) → |S ω| ≤ r * (S.massOn W).toReal) → tsupport b ⊆ W → IsTestForm η → IsTestForm ζ → tsupport η ⊆ tsupport b → tsupport ζ ⊆ tsupport b → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (η x) ≤ K) → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ζ x) ≤ K) → (∀ x, exteriorDerivative η x = (b x * D x) • θ + ζ x) → |∫ x, b x * ξ x θ * D x ∂(μ.restrict W)| ≤ K * ((T.boundary.massOn W).toReal + (T.massOn W).toReal)
